svg.title: MM algo2 listing1
svg.desc: Generated with MathJax 3.2.0 from this TeX (title, then body): \textbf{Listing 1}\quad\text{One round (every } T_s \text{ seconds)} \begin{array}{rll} {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle 1} & \text{reload the settings saved in the admin panel (demo)} & {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle \S\,3} \\[3pt] {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle 2} & \text{read the order book }\mathcal{L}\text{;}\ \ b_0, a_0 \gets \text{best bid, best ask} & {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle \S\,4} \\[3pt] {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle 3} & \textbf{if }\mathcal{L}\text{ is missing or incomplete }\textbf{then }\text{skip the round} & \\[3pt] {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle 4} & \textbf{for each }\text{resting order of ours, at price }P\textbf{ do} & {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle \S\,5} \\[3pt] {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle 5} & \hspace{1.4em}\text{demo: a buy fills if }a_0 \le P\text{, a sell if }b_0 \ge P\text{, at }P\text{, at most }S\text{ per side} & \\[3pt] {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle 6} & \text{cancel our orders older than }T_c & {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle \S\,6} \\[3pt] {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle 7} & q \gets \text{coins held, including those locked in our sells} & {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle \S\,7} \\[3pt] {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle 8} & (B, A) \gets \mathrm{D}{\small\mathrm{ECIDE}}(\mathcal{L}, q)\quad\text{(Listing 2)} & {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle \S\,8} \\[3pt] {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle 9} & \textbf{if }\text{there is no quote }\textbf{then }\text{record the round and stop} & {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle \S\,11.4} \\[3pt] {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle 10} & d \gets m / m_W - 1;\ \ \text{buys pause if } d \le -\theta\text{, sells if } d \ge \theta & {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle \S\,10.1} \\[3pt] {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle 11} & \textbf{for each }\text{side, sells first }\textbf{do} & {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle \S\,10.2} \\[3pt] {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle 12} & \hspace{1.4em}\textbf{if }\text{the side is paused }\textbf{then }\text{cancel its orders; }\textbf{continue} & \\[3pt] {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle 13} & \hspace{1.4em}P \gets \text{the side's new price, } A \text{ or } B & \\[3pt] {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle 14} & \hspace{1.4em}\text{cancel the side's orders that are farther than }w(P)\text{ from }P & \\[3pt] {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle 15} & \hspace{1.4em}\textbf{if }\text{one of them still rests within }w(P)\textbf{ then continue} & \\[3pt] {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle 16} & \hspace{1.4em}n \gets \min\bigl(2S\,x_s,\ q_{\mathrm{free}} - q_{\min}\bigr)\text{ for a sell,}\ \ \min\bigl(2S(1 - x_b),\ C/B\bigr)\text{ for a buy} & {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle \S\,10.3} \\[3pt] {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle 17} & \hspace{1.4em}\textbf{if }n \ge 0.1\,S\text{ and the caps allow it }\textbf{then send }\text{size }n\text{ at }P & {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle \S\,10.4} \\[3pt] {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle 18} & \text{record the round} & {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle \S\,11} \end{array}
